title: Loan Agreement
description: Loan Agreement contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
yaml:
apiVersion: ladder.dev/v1alpha1
kind: Document
metadata:
  name: docubricks-fs-loan-agreement
  title: Loan Agreement
  description: Loan Agreement contract normalized from the DocuBricks Financial services library.
  version: fs_loan_agreement_v1
  source:
    system: docubricks
    sourceId: fs/loan_agreement
    sourcePath: Schemas/fs/loan_agreement
    sourceVersion: fs_loan_agreement_v1
    sourceDigest: f20b738940e07655a721cd3466958136a1bf2e65f2ee705db9c21480c5bd5455
spec:
  documentType: loan_agreement
  sections:
    - id: dates-and-terms
      title: Dates And Terms
      description: Dates And Terms fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - agreement-date
        - amortization-terms
        - maturity-date
    - id: document-details
      title: Document Details
      description: Document Details fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - affirmative-covenants
        - assignment-clause-present
        - facility-type
        - financial-covenants
        - governing-law
        - jurisdiction-venue
        - jury-trial-waiver
        - negative-covenants
    - id: financials
      title: Financials
      description: Financials fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - benchmark-rate
        - commitment-amount
        - default-rate-margin
        - interest-rate-margin
        - interest-rate-type
        - payment-frequency
    - id: line-items
      title: Line Items
      description: Line Items fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - reporting-requirements
    - id: parties
      title: Parties
      description: Parties fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - borrower-name
        - guarantor-names
        - lender-name
    - id: property-or-asset
      title: Property Or Asset
      description: Property Or Asset fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - collateral-description
    - id: risk-and-compliance
      title: Risk And Compliance
      description: Risk And Compliance fields extracted from the document.
      fieldIds:
        - events-of-default
  fields:
    - id: agreement-date
      name: agreement_date
      label: Agreement Date
      description: Date of the agreement.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/agreement_date
    - id: borrower-name
      name: borrower_name
      label: Borrower Name
      description: Borrower legal name.
      dataType: string
      required: true
      sourcePath: /fields/borrower_name
    - id: lender-name
      name: lender_name
      label: Lender Name
      description: Lender, administrative agent, or bank.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/lender_name
    - id: facility-type
      name: facility_type
      label: Facility Type
      description: Term loan, revolving credit facility, delayed draw, line of credit, or other.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/facility_type
    - id: commitment-amount
      name: commitment_amount
      label: Commitment Amount
      description: Principal commitment amount.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/commitment_amount
    - id: maturity-date
      name: maturity_date
      label: Maturity Date
      description: Final maturity date.
      dataType: date
      sourcePath: /fields/maturity_date
    - id: interest-rate-type
      name: interest_rate_type
      label: Interest Rate Type
      description: Fixed, floating, SOFR, prime, base rate, or other.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/interest_rate_type
    - id: interest-rate-margin
      name: interest_rate_margin
      label: Interest Rate Margin
      description: Margin/spread as percent if stated.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/interest_rate_margin
    - id: benchmark-rate
      name: benchmark_rate
      label: Benchmark Rate
      description: SOFR, Term SOFR, Prime, Base Rate, or other.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/benchmark_rate
    - id: default-rate-margin
      name: default_rate_margin
      label: Default Rate Margin
      description: Additional default interest margin.
      dataType: number
      sourcePath: /fields/default_rate_margin
    - id: amortization-terms
      name: amortization_terms
      label: Amortization Terms
      description: Payment/amortization description.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/amortization_terms
    - id: payment-frequency
      name: payment_frequency
      label: Payment Frequency
      description: Monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual, on demand, or other.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/payment_frequency
    - id: collateral-description
      name: collateral_description
      label: Collateral Description
      description: Collateral securing the facility.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/collateral_description
    - id: guarantor-names
      name: guarantor_names
      label: Guarantor Names
      description: Guarantors.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/guarantor_names
    - id: affirmative-covenants
      name: affirmative_covenants
      label: Affirmative Covenants
      description: Affirmative covenants.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/affirmative_covenants
    - id: negative-covenants
      name: negative_covenants
      label: Negative Covenants
      description: Negative covenants.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/negative_covenants
    - id: financial-covenants
      name: financial_covenants
      label: Financial Covenants
      description: DSCR, leverage, liquidity, net worth, borrowing base, or other covenants.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/financial_covenants
    - id: reporting-requirements
      name: reporting_requirements
      label: Reporting Requirements
      description: Financial statements, certificates, borrowing base reports, or other reporting.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/reporting_requirements
    - id: events-of-default
      name: events_of_default
      label: Events Of Default
      description: Events of default.
      dataType: array
      sourcePath: /fields/events_of_default
    - id: governing-law
      name: governing_law
      label: Governing Law
      description: Governing law jurisdiction.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/governing_law
    - id: jurisdiction-venue
      name: jurisdiction_venue
      label: Jurisdiction Venue
      description: Court or venue clause.
      dataType: string
      sourcePath: /fields/jurisdiction_venue
    - id: jury-trial-waiver
      name: jury_trial_waiver
      label: Jury Trial Waiver
      description: Whether a jury trial waiver appears.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/jury_trial_waiver
    - id: assignment-clause-present
      name: assignment_clause_present
      label: Assignment Clause Present
      description: Whether assignments/transfers are addressed.
      dataType: boolean
      sourcePath: /fields/assignment_clause_present
  validationRules:
    - id: borrower-name-present
      severity: error
      description: Loan agreement must identify the borrower.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: borrower_name
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: borrower_name
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: borrower_name IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(borrower_name)) > 0
      supported: true
    - id: commitment-amount-positive
      severity: warning
      description: Commitment amount must be positive when present.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: commitment_amount
          - op: gt
            left:
              field: commitment_amount
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: commitment_amount IS NULL OR commitment_amount > 0
      supported: true
    - id: maturity-after-agreement-date
      severity: warning
      description: Maturity should be after agreement date.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: maturity_date
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: agreement_date
          - op: gt
            left:
              field: maturity_date
            right:
              field: agreement_date
      sourceExpression: maturity_date IS NULL OR agreement_date IS NULL OR maturity_date > agreement_date
      supported: true
    - id: financial-covenants-array-valid
      severity: warning
      description: Financial covenants should be represented as an array.
      rule:
        op: or
        rules:
          - op: not
            rule:
              op: present
              field: financial_covenants
          - op: gte
            left:
              length: financial_covenants
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: financial_covenants IS NULL OR JSON_ARRAY_LENGTH(financial_covenants) >= 0
      supported: true
    - id: governing-law-present
      severity: warning
      description: Governing law is important for legal ops and enforceability review.
      rule:
        op: and
        rules:
          - op: present
            field: governing_law
          - op: gt
            left:
              length: governing_law
            right:
              value: 0
      sourceExpression: governing_law IS NOT NULL AND LENGTH(TRIM(governing_law)) > 0
      supported: true
  reviewPolicy:
    unsupportedRuleAction: human-review
    defaultConfidenceThreshold: 0.75
    fieldConfidence:
      borrower_name:
        minConfidence: 0.94
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Borrower name anchors the legal obligation.
      lender_name:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Lender or agent identity controls document matching.
      commitment_amount:
        minConfidence: 0.95
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: true
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Commitment amount is a core credit exposure field.
      maturity_date:
        minConfidence: 0.92
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Maturity date drives monitoring and renewal workflows.
      financial_covenants:
        minConfidence: 0.82
        reviewOnBreach: true
        failOnBreach: false
        regulatoryRequired: false
        rationale: Financial covenants feed compliance monitoring.
  modelRouting:
    primary: databricks-claude-sonnet
    fallbackChain:
      - databricks-meta-llama-3-70b-instruct
    maxTokens: 6144
    temperature: 0
    timeoutSeconds: 30
    maxRetries: 2
    tierOverrides: {}
    rationale: Loan agreements are long-form legal documents with covenant, event of default, collateral, pricing,
      and jurisdiction language.
  outputSchema:
    type: object
    properties:
      agreement_date:
        type: date
        description: Date of the agreement.
        format: date
      borrower_name:
        type: string
        description: Borrower legal name.
      lender_name:
        type: string
        description: Lender, administrative agent, or bank.
      facility_type:
        type: string
        description: Term loan, revolving credit facility, delayed draw, line of credit, or other.
      commitment_amount:
        type: number
        description: Principal commitment amount.
      maturity_date:
        type: date
        description: Final maturity date.
        format: date
      interest_rate_type:
        type: string
        description: Fixed, floating, SOFR, prime, base rate, or other.
      interest_rate_margin:
        type: number
        description: Margin/spread as percent if stated.
      benchmark_rate:
        type: string
        description: SOFR, Term SOFR, Prime, Base Rate, or other.
      default_rate_margin:
        type: number
        description: Additional default interest margin.
      amortization_terms:
        type: string
        description: Payment/amortization description.
      payment_frequency:
        type: string
        description: Monthly, quarterly, semiannual, annual, on demand, or other.
      collateral_description:
        type: string
        description: Collateral securing the facility.
      guarantor_names:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Guarantors.
      affirmative_covenants:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Affirmative covenants.
      negative_covenants:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Negative covenants.
      financial_covenants:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: DSCR, leverage, liquidity, net worth, borrowing base, or other covenants.
      reporting_requirements:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Financial statements, certificates, borrowing base reports, or other reporting.
      events_of_default:
        type: array
        items:
          type: string
        description: Events of default.
      governing_law:
        type: string
        description: Governing law jurisdiction.
      jurisdiction_venue:
        type: string
        description: Court or venue clause.
      jury_trial_waiver:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether a jury trial waiver appears.
      assignment_clause_present:
        type: boolean
        description: Whether assignments/transfers are addressed.
    required:
      - borrower_name
    additionalProperties: false
  inertSourceMetadata:
    family: commercial_lending
    outputContract:
      fields_object: extracted_fields
      confidence_object: confidence
      metadata_object: extraction_metadata
    completenessChecklist:
      - id: required_fields_present
        description: All required fields are present or explicitly null with low confidence when absent.
        fields:
          - borrower_name
      - id: section_coverage_reviewed
        description: Each declared section was reviewed for extractable evidence.
        sections:
          - dates_and_terms
          - document_details
          - financials
          - line_items
          - parties
          - property_or_asset
          - risk_and_compliance
      - id: nested_lists_normalized
        description: Object array fields use their item_schema for consistent nested extraction.
        fields: []
    sourceFiles:
      - fields.json
      - validation_rules.json
      - field_thresholds.json
      - model_routing.json
